document.description: Valid uniform Schengen visa (Type C) or long-stay national visa (Type D) allows visa-free or simplified entry to additional non-Schengen destinations

unlocks.conditions: Valid multi-entry Schengen visa (Type C or D) or residence permit; must have been used at least once to enter the Schengen Area prior to arrival
unlocks.notes: 90 days within any 180-day period. Visa must be valid for the duration of stay in Albania.

unlocks.conditions: Valid multiple-entry Schengen visa or residence permit; entry must be directly from a Schengen member state, an EU member state, or a country with a bilateral agreement
unlocks.notes: Up to 30 continuous days per entry, capped at 90 days total within any 180-day window.

unlocks.conditions: Holders of designated nationalities under Resolution 5488 holding a Schengen visa (Type C or D) or residence permit with minimum 180 days remaining validity at arrival

source.navigationPath: cancilleria.gov.co > Trámites y Servicios > Visas > Requisitos y Exenciones > Resolución 5488
source.quote: Exención de visa para nacionales de ciertos Estados que sean titulares de permiso de residencia o visado de un Estado que haga parte del Espacio Schengen o de los Estados Unidos de América con vigencia mínima de 180 días al momento del ingreso.

unlocks.notes: Initial stay up to 90 days, extendable up to 180 days per calendar year via Migración Colombia.

unlocks.conditions: Valid visa issued by any Schengen member state; travel strictly for tourism; tourist card required (normally included in commercial airfare)

source.navigationPath: migracion.gob.do > Servicios > Asuntos Migratorios > Condiciones de Entrada para Extranjeros
source.quote: Toda persona que posea una visa válida emitida por los Estados Unidos, Canadá, el Reino Unido o cualquier país de la Unión Europea (Espacio Schengen) puede ingresar al territorio de la República Dominicana con fines turísticos exclusivamente con la compra de una Tarjeta de Turista.

unlocks.notes: Governed by Decrees 691-07 and 286-17. Renewable upon application to General Directorate of Migration.

unlocks.conditions: For specified nationalities applying for a Georgian e-Visa, a valid Schengen visa is accepted as a required supporting document
unlocks.notes: This is a simplified e-Visa eligibility privilege rather than universal visa-free entry. It applies only to nationalities listed by Georgia's e-Visa portal.

unlocks.conditions: Valid, unexpired multiple-entry Schengen visa or permanent residence card; non-remunerated tourist, transit, or business travel
unlocks.notes: Exempts holders of visas requiring FMM; exact duration up to 180 days granted at INM officer discretion.

unlocks.conditions: Valid Schengen visa (multi-entry Type C or Type D) or residence permit; must remain valid for the entire stay
unlocks.notes: Up to 30 days per entry (or until the visa expiration date if fewer than 30 days remain).

unlocks.conditions: Valid multiple-entry short-stay Schengen visa (Type C) or long-stay visa (Type D); visa validity must extend at least 5 days beyond planned departure
unlocks.notes: Up to 15 days per entry, with total stay not exceeding 90 days within any 180-day period.

unlocks.conditions: Valid visa or residence issued by a qualifying country, including an EU member state; a Schengen visa issued by an EU member state can satisfy this route
unlocks.notes: Current Panama guidance cites Executive Decrees 521 and 196. Decree 196 removed the former six-month minimum remaining-validity condition, requiring the qualifying visa to be valid at entry.

unlocks.conditions: Restricted privilege: strictly for Indian and Chinese (PRC) nationals holding a valid multiple-entry Schengen visa; passport valid 6+ months; confirmed onward/return ticket

source.navigationPath: immigration.gov.ph > Visa Requirements > Non-Immigrant Visa > Temporary Visitor Visa > Special Exemption Guidelines
source.quote: Indian nationals with a valid and current Schengen, American, Japanese, Australian, Canadian, Singaporean, or UK visa may enter the Philippines visa-free for an initial stay not exceeding fourteen (14) days. Chinese nationals may enter for an initial stay of seven (7) days under comparable conditions.

unlocks.notes: Under Bureau of Immigration Operations Order No. SBM-2014-041 and FSC 28-11. Indian nationals extendable by 7 days. This rule does not apply universally to all visa-required nationalities.

unlocks.conditions: Valid multiple-entry Schengen visa (Type C), national long-stay visa (Type D), or residence permit; valid for duration of stay
unlocks.notes: Up to 90 days within any 6-month (180-day) period under the Government Decision on Visa Exemption.

unlocks.conditions: Nationals of conditional e-Visa eligible countries; must possess a valid physical Schengen sticker visa or residence permit (electronic Schengen visas/permits not accepted)

source.navigationPath: evisa.gov.tr > Information > Who is eligible for e-Visa > Conditional e-Visa prerequisites
source.quote: Certain passport holders require a valid supporting document (Schengen visa or valid residence permit from any of the Schengen countries, USA, UK, or Ireland) to be eligible for a Turkish e-Visa. E-visas of other countries are not accepted as supporting documents.

unlocks.notes: Single-entry e-Visa issued via official MFA portal based on supporting Schengen physical visa.
